chung.Description:
This course will introduce the student to the essential aspects of information security and network forensics. The student will be provided with the tools, techniques and industry accepted methodologies so that upon completion of the course the student will be able to describe key concepts of network security and forensics and how those concepts apply to themselves and their organization.

The course is based on Courses 1, 2 and 6 of the SSCP Professional Training Certificate, the whole will show employers you have the IT security foundation to defend against cyber attacks – and puts you on a clear path to earning SSCP certification.
chung.StudentTasks:
1. Complete three online courses 1, 2 ,6 to be allowed to take Final Exam

2. Final Exam included Final Theory Exam (TE): 100%

3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & (Final TE Score + bonus) >= 5

Understand the different access control systems and how they should be implemented to protect the system and data using the different levels of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
LO1.1 Describe how to implement Authentication mechanisms
LO1.2 Identify and operate internetwork trust architectures
LO1.3 Describe the process of administering identity management life cycle
LO1.4 Implement the different types of access controls (Subject/Object based)

Achieve basic security concepts and the application of those concepts in the day to day operation and administration of enterprise computer systems and the information that they host.
LO2.1 Define Code of Ethics, describe the security concepts, Document and operate security
controls"
LO2.2 Describe the asset management process
LO2.3 Implement and assess compliance controls
LO2.4 Describe the change management process
LO2.5 Contribute to the security awareness training program and physical security operations

Know concepts in endpoint device security, cloud infrastructure security, securing big data systems, securing virtual environments, and how an organization can protect itself from these attacks.
LO3.1 Identify malicious activity, describe malicious code and the various countermeasures
LO3.2 Describe the processes for operating endpoint device security, and mobile device management processes
LO3.3 Describe the process for configuring cloud security
LO3.4 Explain and summarize the process for securing big data systems and virtual environments
